proof_body:
by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨g, hg | hg⟩ := exists_increasing_or_nonincreasing_subseq (· < ·) x
  · exact ⟨g, g.strictMono, Or.inl (monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n => (hg n (n + 1) (Nat.lt_succ_self n)).le)⟩
  · refine ⟨g, g.strictMono, Or.inr fun m n hmn => ?_⟩
    rcases hmn.eq_or_lt with rfl | h
    · exact le_rfl
    · exact not_lt.1 (hg m n h)
target_source: ∀ x : ℕ → ℝ, ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono p ∧ (Monotone (fun n => x (p n)) ∨ Antitone (fun n => x (p n)))
